content: Cliptop: Clipboard history for Mac, right under the notch. | Product Hunt Launching today Cliptop Launching today Clipboard history for Mac, right under the notch. 85 followers Clipboard history for Mac, right under the notch. 85 followers Visit website Cliptop is a fast, local-first clipboard manager for Mac. Open it from the notch or menu bar, search recent copies, preview text, links, code, images, files, and colors, save key items to Pinboards, and paste back without losing focus. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Options Launch tags: Mac • Productivity • Menu Bar Apps 10% Lifetime discount Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 16 Day Rank Upvote • 108 points Follow Cliptop Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info cliptop.app App Store Cliptop Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/cliptop Similar Products Paste A better way to copy and paste on Mac, iPhone, and iPad 4.8 ( 32 reviews ) Note and writing apps Team collaboration software Maccy Lightweight. Open source. No fluff. 5.0 ( 4 reviews ) Productivity Note and writing apps Alfred Productivity App for macOS 5.0 ( 19 reviews ) Productivity Automation tools Pastebot I'm a versatile clipboard manager for your Mac. 5.0 ( 1 review ) Pasta Clipboard time machine 5.0 ( 1 review ) Productivity Note and writing apps View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Razvan Ilin Chartbrew Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I built Cliptop because I wanted clipboard history to feel as fast as copy and paste itself. I use the keyboard for almost everything on my Mac, and most clipboard managers still felt like they made me pause: open a window, scan a list, reach for the mouse, pick something, then get back to what I was doing. Cliptop is my attempt at making clipboard history feel invisible. Hit a shortcut, search what you copied, press Enter, and keep going. No context switch, no digging around, no breaking flow. It opens from the notch/top edge or by pressing Shift+Cmd+V, but the main idea is speed: recent copies, previews, Pinboards, and paste actions that are quick enough to use constantly throughout the day. It’s local-first too, so your clipboard history stays on your Mac. Private iCloud sync with the Cliptop iOS app coming soon as well, but that will be an optional feature. I’d love your feedback on the flow: does Cliptop feel fast enough to become muscle memory? And what keyboard-first paste actions would you want next? Thanks for checking it out! InstantDelay lets OBS & Streamlabs streamers: Add, Remove, or Adjust stream delay while already live. Built for competitive streamers, tournaments, subathons, and multi-streaming, with Instant Mode, Overlay Mode, custom overlays, hotkeys, and Stream Deck support. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Options Launch tags: Video Streaming • SaaS • Live Events 3 Months Free Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 24 Day Rank Upvote • 79 points Follow InstantDelay Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info instant-delay.com InstantDelay Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/instantdelay Similar Products Restream Live stream on YouTube, LinkedIn, X and 30+ other 4.9 ( 10 reviews ) Social Networking Live streaming platforms OneStream Live Create, schedule & multistream videos on social media & web 4.8 ( 26 reviews ) Scheduling software Meeting software Twitch Livestream multiplayer games & esports 4.7 ( 9 reviews ) Social Networking Live streaming platforms Gyre Tool for 24/7 live streaming of pre-recorded content 5.0 ( 94 reviews ) Live streaming platforms Magicam Real-time face swapping for any stream or meeting 5.0 ( 6 reviews ) Video editing Camera apps View more Subscribe Sign in Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Dylan SANT InstantDelay Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Lyp, a streamer and creator, and I built InstantDelay because fixed stream delay is still one of the most frustrating parts of streaming competitive games. Delay is useful when you need protection against stream sniping, ghosting, or unfair information sharing. But the second you want to talk with chat, take a break, review a game, or switch to a more interactive segment, that same delay becomes a problem. Until now, streamers usually had to choose before going live: 1. Use delay for the whole stream and lose real-time interaction. 2. Stream with no delay and accept the risk. 3. Restart the stream or use complicated workarounds. InstantDelay makes delay flexible. It works as a desktop app and RTMP bridge between OBS / Streamlabs and your streaming platform, so you can add, remove, or adjust delay while you are already live. There are two main modes: Instant Mode : Change delay immediately. Overlay Mode : Show viewers a custom overlay while the delay switches, so the transition feels clean and understandable. It also supports multi-stream workflows, custom OBS overlays, Stream Deck actions, and hotkeys. content: CashOut: Block sports betting apps, track how much you saved | Product Hunt Launching today CashOut Launching today Block sports betting apps, track how much you saved 53 followers Block sports betting apps, track how much you saved 53 followers Visit website Safety and Privacy platforms You've seen it everywhere. Every ad break, every broadcast, every group chat. In just a few years, sports betting went from taboo to unavoidable, run by companies that profit when you lose and design their apps to keep vulnerable people addicted. CashOut fights back. And every day that you don't bet, you track how much money you've saved. CashOut. Bet on yourself. title: DeskArcade
summary: An arcade in your menu bar - playable over anything
content: DeskArcade: An arcade in your menu bar - playable over anything | Product Hunt Launching today DeskArcade Launching today An arcade in your menu bar - playable over anything 67 followers An arcade in your menu bar - playable over anything 67 followers Visit website A native macOS menu-bar app that drops a transparent arcade of ten micro-games over your real desktop. Press ⌘⌥B, play for 90 seconds, press it againit's gone. Free, notarised, doesn't touch your real apps. Overview Reviews Built with Forum Team More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Menu Bar Apps • Games Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 23 Day Rank Upvote • 83 points Follow DeskArcade Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info getdeskarcade.com DeskArcade Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/deskarcade Subscribe Sign in Forum Threads p/deskarcade Pratik Garg • 1d ago What would you want DeskArcade to do beyond games? DeskArcade launched as 10 tiny games that live over your desktop but a few people have started asking "what else could this do?", and honestly I'm curious where the community's head is at. The core of it isn't really the games it's the transparent layer that floats over your real screen and can react to what you're doing, without taking over your workflow. Games are just the first thing living on it. So I'm genuinely asking: what would you want on that layer? A few directions I've been mulling: 0 2 View all Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Pratik Garg DeskArcade Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Pratik, solo maker of DeskArcade.It started as a dumb idea: what if I could flick a basketball at a hoop over my actual screen during a boring meeting, and dismiss it before anyone noticed? That turned into 10 tiny games that live in your menu bar, hit ⌘⌥B and a transparent arcade appears over whatever you're doing. Blow up the Slack icon in Desk Invaders, race an F1 lap around your windows, whack goons climbing out of your real Chrome. Hit ⌘⌥B again, gone.A few things people usually ask: It's native + fast and single Swift binary, no Electron, no bloat. It doesn't touch your real apps , it reads app icons to draw them; destroying the Slack alien doesn't close Slack. No screen-recording or accessibility permissions. It's free, notarised, macOS 13+. It's genuinely just me building this in my spare time, and the roadmap is being shaped by what people ask for and I'm already getting great feature requests (and honestly thinking about where the "layer over your desktop" idea could go beyond games).I'll be here all day , would love to know: what's the first thing you'd do with it, and what would you want it to do next? Roast it, request things, tell me it's a terrible idea for productivity. I'm listening. content: The City Mesh: Fund your project with a 3D city of sponsors | Product Hunt Launching today The City Mesh Launching today Fund your project with a 3D city of sponsors 58 followers Fund your project with a 3D city of sponsors 58 followers Visit website Crowdfunding Get funded from day one, no debt, no equity. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Launch tags: Fintech • Marketing • SaaS Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 32 Day Rank Upvote • 71 points Follow The City Mesh Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info thecitymesh.com The City Mesh Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/the-city-mesh Similar Products Buy Me a Coffee A supporter is worth a thousand followers 3.5 ( 26 reviews ) Crowdfunding Membership software Station Podcast Revenue Assistant that Helps You Find Sponsors 5.0 ( 6 reviews ) Humance Change the world in a few clicks 4.9 ( 8 reviews ) Social & Community Crowdfunding Ko-fi.com Fund Your Passions. 4.8 ( 4 reviews ) Membership software Marketplace sites Drope.me Engage Micro Streamers at Scale to Grow Your Games 5.0 ( 4 reviews ) Advertising tools Games View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Xussof The City Mesh Maker 📌 Hey hunters! 👋 I built The City Mesh to give creators, startups and artists a way to get funded from day one , no debt, no equity. Instead of a boring donation page, your supporters claim a hexagon on a living 3D city. Their name and logo rise on a building, and the more they contribute, the bigger it grows. The twist: prices rise with scarcity as your city fills up, so the people who believe in you first pay the least — and their hex is theirs forever, even if you become the next unicorn. It's public proof of who backs you, embeddable anywhere with a single iframe, and payouts go straight to your Stripe.
